visual_review.method: A separate read-only codex exec session received only the card URL, exact submission URL and four original PNG attachments. The main verifier then compared the raw observations with current AC-02.
observations: 375px light: clear hierarchy, visible control boundaries, even spacing, no obstruction or horizontal overflow; title and creation time readable; long-task checkbox and delete control are vertically centered away from the first text line.

375px dark: same hierarchy and spacing; visible boundaries and readable title, time and long text; no obstruction or horizontal overflow; the long-task checkbox is not aligned with the first text line and the delete border is faint but still recognizable.

1280px light: centered main content, aligned title/card edge, clear input/filter/list separation, sufficient spacing, no obstruction or overflow; long-task checkbox and delete control remain vertically centered.

1280px dark: layout matches light desktop; hierarchy, separators and card boundaries clear, readable content and discoverable controls, no obstruction or overflow; long-task checkbox remains vertically centered and delete border is faint but recognizable.

issues.before: Long-task checkboxes and delete controls sit vertically centered away from the first text line in all four states.
issues.after: No P0-P2 issue found; P3 remains a polish item and does not block AC-02.

visual_review.ac02_result: PASS: no P0-P2 issue; all four target states were actually viewed. Static screenshots do not prove click/keyboard behavior, which was covered separately by the runtime interaction checks.
